title: Franklin Coziness
description:
Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located house just 3 miles from downtown Franklin, TN. 

Guests will enjoy their own bedroom and bath upstairs and have access to the downstairs kitchen, living room and back patio. 

Downtown Nashville is just 15 miles away. There are large shopping areas, including a mall, just 4 miles away. 

Easy access to I-65. Splendid location for back road exploring and enjoying historic sites.
